title: 第21章 礼尚往来第22章 抱歉最近有点上火
lines: 勾栏，教坊司，这样的烟花柳巷之地，作为一个现代人，宁宸还是很好奇的。
但宁宸以自己年纪小拒绝了他们的盛情邀请。
第一，太贵，虽然是别人请客...但以后肯定得还回去。
第二，太小...他说的是年纪。
跟他们瞎聊了一阵，宁宸再次扛起圆木跑了起来。
中午的时候，陈老将军备了酒宴。
宁宸陪陈老将军喝了几杯。
这个时代的酿酒工艺不行，所以酒的度数也不高。
下午，宁宸继续锻炼。
他必须尽快让自己变得强壮起来。
宁宸的毅力，让那些将士都佩服不已。
临走时，陈老将军还送了宁宸几包药，说是回去沐浴的时候放在浴桶里，可活血化瘀，缓解肌肉酸痛。
宁宸道谢后，拎着几包药回宁府。
他现在的确浑身酸痛，跟被人打了一顿似的，这就是长时间不锻炼造成的。
回去泡个热水澡，再加上陈老将军给的药，应该能舒服些。
正想着，身后突然间响起一阵尖叫声！
宁宸下意识的回头，就看到一辆马车，以极快的速度朝着他冲撞过来。
此时，马车离他不过三米。
一股寒意瞬间袭遍全身。
但求生的本能让宁宸立刻做出反应，猛地朝着旁边扑去。
宁宸摔在地上，顺势滚了几圈。
马车呼啸而过，带起一阵狂风，绝尘而去。
“年轻人，你没事吧？”
“那匹马好像受惊了。”
“太危险了，差点就撞到这个年轻人了。”
路人围过来，有好心人将宁宸扶起来。
“谢谢，我没事！”
宁宸锻炼了一天，浑身酸疼，刚才那一摔，也没感觉到更疼。
唯一让他心疼的就是身上的大氅弄脏了。
谢过帮忙的路人，宁宸朝着宁府的方向走去。
他的眼睛微眯着，目光闪烁。
那匹马没有受惊，那辆马车就是冲着他来的。
content_en:
Goulan, Jiaofangsi, such a place with fireworks and willow alleys, as a modern person, Ning Chen is still very curious.
But Ning Chen refused their kind invitation because of his young age.
First, it’s too expensive. Even though it’s someone else’s treat... I’ll definitely have to pay it back in the future.
Second, too young... He was talking about age.
After chatting with them for a while, Ning Chen picked up the log again and started running.
At noon, General Chen prepared a banquet.
Ning Chen had a few drinks with Old General Chen.
The wine-making process of this era was not good, so the alcohol content was not high.
In the afternoon, Ning Chen continued to exercise.
He had to get stronger as soon as possible.
Ning Chen's perseverance impressed all the soldiers.
Before leaving, General Chen also gave Ning Chen a few packets of medicine, saying that when he went back to take a bath, he would put it in the tub to activate blood circulation, remove blood stasis, and relieve muscle soreness.
After Ning Chen thanked him, he returned to Ning Mansion with a few bags of medicine.
He was indeed sore now, as if he had been beaten. This was caused by not exercising for a long time.
Go back and take a hot bath, plus the medicine given by General Chen, you should feel better.
Just as I was thinking about it, a scream suddenly sounded from behind me!
Ning Chen turned around subconsciously and saw a carriage rushing towards him at an extremely fast speed.
At this time, the carriage was no more than three meters away from him.
A chill instantly ran through his body.
But the instinct of survival made Ning Chen react immediately and rush to the side.
Ning Chen fell to the ground and rolled several times.
The carriage roared past, bringing up a gust of wind, and flew away.
"Young man, are you okay?"
"The horse seemed frightened."
"It was too dangerous. I almost hit this young man."
Passers-by gathered around and a kind person helped Ning Chen up.
"Thank you, I'm fine!"
Ning Chen had been exercising for a day, and his whole body was sore. He didn't feel any more pain from the fall just now.
The only thing that bothered him was that the cloak on his body was stained.
Ning Chen thanked the passers-by for their help and walked towards Ning Mansion.
His eyes were slightly narrowed and his gaze flickered.
The horse was not frightened, the carriage was coming for him.
title_en: Chapter 21: Reciprocity Chapter 22: Sorry, I’ve been a little angry lately
